Package org.example

Class Pizzeria

java.lang.Object
org.example.Pizzeria
public class Pizzeria extends Object
Main pizzeria class - manages the production process. Shutdown strategy: stop accepting orders, all remaining orders in the queue and storage are serialized to a file for completion the next day.

      Places a new order in the queue.
      Returns:
      created order or null if orders are not being accepted

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Shuts down the pizzeria. 1. Stops accepting new orders. 2. Closes the order queue. 3. Interrupts bakers (immediate stop strategy). 4. Closes storage. 5. Interrupts couriers. 6. Serializes unfinished orders.

    • isAcceptingOrders
